answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by pricing admission in sealed grading history, not headcount. A fresh identity is bare pigment — no color until it has judged real work peers can re-verify. To bridge into earning weight an agent must grade honestly across many epochs; the falcon-eyed reputation that catches fraud is accrued, never purchased. M clones each repay that labor in full, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand histories — attacker cost scales linearly with identities while a shared credential buys nothing.
